user.title: Chastity Calendar
user.description: Give this calendar a name, then choose the services to track and optionally enable Obedience sync. Each setup has its own credentials, calendar, session history, points and settings.

data.services: Services to track (select any combination, or none)
data.instance_name: Name for this setup (for example John or Craig)

emlalock.title: Configure EmlaLock
emlalock.description: Enter your EmlaLock details. Leave them blank to configure this service later.

chaster.title: Configure Chaster
chaster.description: Enter your Chaster Developer Token. Leave it blank to configure this service later.

chastify.title: Configure Chastify
chastify.description: Enter your Chastify API key. Leave it blank to configure this service later.

obedience.title: Connect to Obedience
obedience.description: Select Open external website to sign in to Obedience and authorize Chastity Calendar. You will return here automatically; your Obedience password is never entered into Home Assistant.

obedience_settings.title: Obedience habits
obedience_settings.description: Authorization does not require habit IDs. After connecting, enter either ID if you want that milestone synced; leave both blank to finish setup without habit syncing.

data.obedience_daily_habit_id: Daily-completion habit ID (optional; leave blank to skip)
data.obedience_yearly_habit_id: 365-day milestone habit ID (optional; leave blank to skip)

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Chastity Calendar instance is supported.
abort.obedience_https_required: Obedience authorization needs an HTTPS Home Assistant URL. Configure an HTTPS external URL, or enable Home Assistant Cloud Remote UI.
abort.obedience_authorization_failed: Obedience authorization could not be verified. Please try again.

init.title: Notification preferences
init.description: Change only the monthly notification destination and notification targets. Other settings are fixed after initial setup.

data.monthly_notification_targets: Phone notification targets (select one or multiple phones)

emlalock.title: Configure EmlaLock
emlalock.description: Enter your EmlaLock details. Leave them blank to configure this service later.

chaster.title: Configure Chaster
chaster.description: Enter your Chaster Developer Token. Leave it blank to configure this service later.

chastify.title: Configure Chastify
chastify.description: Enter your Chastify API key. Leave it blank to configure this service later.

obedience.title: Connect to Obedience
obedience.description: Select Open external website to sign in to Obedience and authorize Chastity Calendar. You will return here automatically; your Obedience password is never entered into Home Assistant.

obedience_settings.title: Obedience habits
obedience_settings.description: Choose the optional Obedience habits to increment after authorization. Leave a habit ID blank to skip syncing that milestone.

error.invalid_options: Invalid events JSON or options. Check that months are unique values from 1 to 12 and each event has a title.

mark_day_complete.name: Mark day complete
mark_day_complete.description: Manually award points for a date. Omit the date to use today. If multiple setups exist, provide the setup name.

sync_missing_points.name: Check and retry missing Obedience syncs
sync_missing_points.description: Retry missing Obedience syncs for one setup. If multiple setups exist, provide the setup name.
